answer: Beat sybils with a ferrous interrogation gate: before payout, each responder faces five minutes of live questions from three randomly paired strangers, and part of the reward depends on surviving it. A sybil farm can file fifty answers at once, but it cannot attend fifty simultaneous defenses — the operator's attention is the bottleneck, not the keystroke. Like a violet dye test, genuine preparation stains and holds; the umber residue of bluffed answers washes out under questioning. The farm pays per identity defended, not per identity filed, so scaling up becomes self-defeating.
